scope: Preparacao documental ORDEM018 F3; nao lote executavel nem veredito.
recommendation: A for review: compatible admitted median helper and all named-file geometries. This recommendation uses metadata only, does not ratify A, validate threshold or release any hold.

common_parameters_proposed.onsource_start: Reuse exact sample-aligned t0 from pinned metadata; do not recompute rounded GPS-16
common_parameters_proposed.onsource_window: Bilby Tukey; alpha=2*0.4/32=0.025; record window_factor and apply exactly once
common_parameters_proposed.window: hann, periodic/DFT-even as SciPy get_window default
common_parameters_proposed.PSD_interpolation: None needed on identical grid; assert grid equality/domain before Bilby; no extrapolation
common_parameters_proposed.interval_rule: First full integer-second block in named 4096 s file passing registered DQ/no-injection bits and finiteness, with end <= limit; per detector separately. No scan by PSD level, stationarity or fit quality.
common_parameters_proposed.onsource_rule: Existing 32 s exact sample-aligned interval, all required DQ/no-injection bits and finite samples; no recentering from signal
common_parameters_proposed.gating: None. No clipping, inpainting, transient deletion or PSD-driven gate selection. Fail quality/stationarity -> HOLD; changing rule needs prior independent review.

lines.handling: Include lines in measured PSD, no whitening/notching based on signal. Official line list not identified in inspected sources; any fixed mask alternative must be separately pinned before data selection.

calibration.required: Detector/release identity, strain convention/units, epoch-valid calibration provenance, amplitude/phase envelope paths+hashes+frequency/GPS validity and pre-fixed treatment.
calibration.observed: Zenodo descriptions declare envelopes within PE releases. Internal paths, availability per detector/event and values not read.
calibration.missing_policy: HOLD_CALIBRATION; do not claim scientific PE readiness or set uncertainty to zero by default.

alternatives.estimator: Welch median with SciPy median-bias correction
alternatives.segment_overlap_dependence: 15 overlapping periodograms are not 15 independent realizations; correction does not prove Gaussianity/stationarity.
alternatives.existing_code: offsource_psd supports estimator and configurable duration as is; diagnostics/receipts still require separate reviewed implementation.
alternatives.selection_effect: 14/14 named-file geometries accommodate duration if DQ valid, including four holds which remain holds.
alternatives.conditional_error_scope: PSD fixed estimate gives conditional PE errors; no PSD uncertainty marginalization or coverage claim.
alternatives.rationale: Less offsource and compatible estimator in admitted helper; shorter estimate has greater PSD estimation uncertainty.

alternatives.existing_code: Installed scipy.signal.welch supports mean; admitted strain_io hardcodes median. Needs isolated reviewed adapter change BEFORE any data stage; no such adapter built here.
alternatives.selection_effect: 13/14 named-file geometries accommodate duration. GW250118_170523 H1/L1 blocked before DQ under this exact pre-event rule; do not silently shorten, switch to A or fetch a different file.
alternatives.conditional_error_scope: Conditional on plug-in PSD; mean is more exposed to transients. No bias/coverage measured.
alternatives.rationale: Longer averaging sample and conventional mean. Deliberate alternative, not fallback or a detector-by-detector choice after seeing data.

stationarity_proposed.when: AFTER deterministic DQ+finiteness interval selection; never scan new interval following diagnostic failure
stationarity_proposed.partition: Two equal nonoverlapping halves of chosen offsource; same 32 s Hann50% estimator as selected alternative.
stationarity_proposed.statistic: For each band, P_j=sum_{k in band} S_j(f_k)*delta_f; R=max(P_1,P_2)/min(P_1,P_2). All finite and positive; proposed accept R<=2 in every band.
stationarity_proposed.threshold_status: INPUT. Not a confidence bound or measured false-alarm rate. Needs synthetic qualification and prior ratification before real offsource.
stationarity_proposed.failure: HOLD_STATIONARITY; record complete diagnostics, no reroll/no interval reselection/no estimator switch.
stationarity_proposed.limitations: Only coarse temporal consistency within offsource; does not prove stationarity at onsource or characterize all narrow lines. No onsource/fit/posterior used to choose threshold.
stationarity_proposed.PSD_uncertainty: Finite-sample/overlap and estimator uncertainty require separate synthetic controls or declared conditional treatment before inferential claims.

DQ_configuration.validation: Require matching flag dictionaries, integer bit-vectors, 1 Hz coverage, correct GPS/sample alignment, all required bits set over both offsource and onsource, finite strain; failures visible.
DQ_configuration.old_T07_rule: Do not import descriptive ratio>10 as a cut; that threshold was post-data diagnostic, not registered selection.

selection_by_metadata.criteria_V1_verbatim: eligible = quality_INPUT (SNR_rede >= 12; M_f,det mediana >= 40 Msun; 0 <= chi_f < 0,98; fonte GWOSC/GR IMR) E ausente do corpus de publicacao congelado em 22/09 20:32Z (PUBLICATION_CENSUS: FOUND = analise publicada que admite desvios QNM de f/tau) E fora do GWTC-5.0 33 / GWTC-3 18 / corpus auditado de 39
selection_by_metadata.freeze_V1_verbatim: NÃO CONGELADO NESTE V1 (os 4 holds e os 8 pendentes podem mudar a lista); o conjunto congela por evento na v387, no estágio cego, ANTES de qualquer PE abrir; o critério é o que congela aqui
selection_by_metadata.four_holds_can_only_change: Separate explicit metadata-based decision and reviewed evidence before any PE; current document changes none.
selection_by_metadata.eight_pending_outside_list: No additions/reconciliation/eligibility changes in this task.
selection_by_metadata.H1_L1_block: One event for inference, both detectors same chosen policy; one missing detector -> HOLD under this proposal, no single-detector substitution.
selection_by_metadata.blindness: No delta-tau, posterior center, H0, fit/Bayes factor or signal residual used for metadata selection; catalogue GR eligibility criteria inherited, not recalculated.

later_process_before_verdict: Review proposal and choose ONE A/B globally by metadata; ratify grid/window, DQ names/semantics, line and calibration policies, stationarity rule and cost contract.
Identify exact approved metadata/envelope artifacts by hash; seek scoped operator permission for opening D. This document grants none.
If authorized, metadata-only inspection first; preserve existing holds until explicit documented decision. Missing metadata stops progression.

After separately authorized offsource stage, verify file hashes/sample alignment/DQ, choose deterministic first valid block; compute pinned PSD and diagnostics, retain failed rows and stop without fallback.
Review selected PSD/DQ/calibration manifest and event selection independently; freeze per-event inputs BEFORE PE or posterior access.
Only then separate PE/cost authorization with already required injection/bias/coverage/family/systematic gates; negative or incomplete controls remain visible. No two-job coverage inference.
Any later verdict uses its own registered function/inputs/covariance and checks; no verdict in current task.
